summary: test_arrow_then_enter_selects_a_filtered_candidate_without_submitting exercises real Input/OptionList key routing (arrow-driven highlight, Enter via _LaunchInput.on_key -> accept_launch_candidate) and asserts both the field takes the highlighted candidate's value and the memo is not submitted (screen stays MemoScreen, fake.created empty); covers both model and effort fields, correctly excludes the no-highlight case (REQ-018.17).
